assumptions_and_boundaries: The target, protected rows, model, and useful update are supplied, not discovered.
The x_2=0 extension uses the no-bias-change premise. A single augmented anchor alone would not span that entire affine feature line.
Protecting the target is incompatible with changing it by +1.
Protecting both coordinate directions forces no-op and misses the target.
The plot includes an illustrative one-dimensional family of exact-target edits and the no-op; it is not an exhaustive optimizer interface.
The compiler example uses positive ridge and can leave target error; it is not identical to the exact target-only preset.
This arithmetic does not certify native floating-point execution, changing features, nonlinear networks, general safety, or live LLM ability.
